review:
A retro 5x3 joker game with a funky soundtrack. Hot Wilds can pop up and merge with any symbol on the grid, boosting your chances.

A bonus round kicks in as Hot and Hot Wild symbols collect on the grid. The joker is the top symbol. Simple and nostalgic, built around one key mechanic. 96.5% RTP.
